Title: App Service Authentication portal experience is now in public preview

Body.Content:
A new version of the App Service Authentication/Authorization portal experience is now in public preview, making it even easier to set up client authentication for your app. In the Azure portal, this will appear as “Authentication (Preview)” alongside the existing experience during the course of the preview. However, the two experiences cannot be used at the same time, and apps already using the Authentication/Authorization feature are not yet recommended to migrate to the new version.

This is an early preview that will receive periodic updates to add new capabilities and simplify the experience. Feedback may be provided through the “Send us your feedback” option built into the experience. At this initial announcement, only the Azure Active Directory provider is supported.

Learn more.
